text: The posted answer is unsupported for the route distance: it uses the full Wikipedia lengths of I-40 (2,556.61 mi) and I-90 (3,099.74 mi), but the user asked for the trip from Los Angeles to Cincinnati and then Cincinnati to Augusta. Those are only segments of those interstates, so the 5,656.35-mile total is not evidenced by the posted sources.

Verified via Wikipedia pages: California standard bottle deposit is 5¢ and Maine standard bottle deposit is 5¢; I-40 length is 2,556.61 mi and I-90 length is 3,099.74 mi. I could not verify Wikipedia segment mileage for Los Angeles→Cincinnati on I-40 or Cincinnati→Augusta on I-90. A non-Wikipedia route page for Cincinnati→Augusta shows 1,022.8 mi by road and says the route follows I-80/I-84/I-71/I-95 with only 8 mi on I-90, so it does not support the requested I-90 segment.
